spaces.address: 72 Walker St, 3rd Fl. (entrance on Cortlandt Alley), New York, NY 10013

notes:
Founded 2016 by artists Shelby Jackson and Paul Gondry in a namesake Orient Ave, Williamsburg townhouse (the name predates this address); the gallery has since relocated its main space here, entrance on Cortlandt Alley — this is the address confirmed directly on the site's own visit/contact info. Just the one space — a second 'Brooklyn location' was briefly tracked as a separate registry entry based on a since-disputed secondary source; removed 2026-08-19 per direct correction from the user, who knows this gallery firsthand. Current show at add time: Skip Laplante, '48 Wind Chimes' (Jun 28–Jul 11), a site-specific sound installation.
